articles.title: Nvidia's Jensen Huang faces Senate scrutiny despite Trump-backed return as CEO
articles.snippet: Congressional scrutiny will continue even as CEO returns to lead the company after his affair scandal and its national-security implications.

articles.title: Binance hackers push $247 million through transactions designed to cloud the source
articles.snippet: Elliptic found that nearly all the mixing transactions, known as coinjoins, were coordinated by an entity called Kruw during fixed daily hours, suggesting potential handoffs to China-based money launderers.

articles.title: CFTC staff say exchanges can count Bitcoin toward operating reserves
articles.snippet: The staff guidance allows Bitcoin, Ether and payment stablecoins to count towards operating reserves.

articles.title: BTCS offloads $44M in ETH to reduce DeFi debt amid market downturn
articles.snippet: BTCS sold more than half its Ether holdings to reduce leverage following the market sell-off, while BitMine added another 7,819 ETH to its treasury.

articles.title: Cross River Bank enters Bitcoin-backed lending with $250K loans
articles.snippet: The US bank is offering Bitcoin-backed loans ranging from $10,000 to $250,000 through LendingUSA, allowing borrowers to access cash without selling their holdings.
